questions.stem_text:
For which of the following statements are both the price change and quantity change
determinable (for a particular good)?

options.A: Both the supply of and the demand for the good decrease.
options.B: Both the supply of and the demand for the good increase.
options.C: The supply increases and the demand for the good decreases.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - None of the above.

questions.stem_text: The money supply will increase as a result of which of the following?

options.A: A decrease in the required reserve ratio
options.B: An increase in the discount rate
options.C: The selling of bonds by the Federal Reserve
options.D: An increase in the fraction of deposits that must be held by banks

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - A decrease in the required reserve ratio

questions.stem_text:
When both short-run aggregate supply and aggregate demand increase which of the following
can be said for certain?

options.A: The price level rises but real GDP falls.
options.B: Both the price level and real GDP rise.
options.C: The price level rises but the change in real GDP is uncertain.
options.D: Real GDP rises but the change in the price level is uncertain.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - Real GDP rises but the change in the price level is uncertain.

questions.stem_text: A consequence of a price floor is

options.A: a persistent shortage of the good.
options.C: a persistent surplus of the good.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - a persistent surplus of the good.
